career_objective: Aspiring Software Engineer pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (AI & ML) at Vel Tech University, seeking to apply strong foundations in Java, Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, and SQL toward full-stack and Generative & Agentic AI (Google Gemini, Google ADK, OpenRouter) roles.

projects.name: PhishHunter AI
description: Developed an AI-powered Chrome Extension to analyze URLs, emails, and SMS messages for phishing detection using Machine Learning, NLP, and heuristic analysis.
Built a Flask REST API and deployed it on Render to provide cloud-hosted, real-time phishing detection services.
Integrated domain reputation analysis, redirect detection, suspicious keyword identification, and intelligent threat scoring.
Designed a responsive browser extension interface that provides risk scores, threat indicators, and actionable recommendations.
Improved practical experience in REST API development, browser extension architecture, cloud deployment, and AI-powered content analysis.

projects.name: CivicVoice
description: Built a full-stack platform enabling citizens to report civic infrastructure issues with geolocation tagging, and giving administrators a dashboard to track and resolve them.
Designed a Python/FastAPI microservice for AI-driven urgency scoring and automated duplicate report detection, integrated with the Node.js backend via REST APIs.
Implemented hotspot clustering (DBSCAN) to identify recurring problem zones, JWT-based authentication with OTP email verification, and role-based access control for citizens, officials, and admins.
Deployed the full distributed system to production - frontend on Vercel, backend and ML microservice on Render, and MySQL database on Aiven Cloud.

projects.name: Axis
description: Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that lets users control the browser by voice, combining live DOM analysis and screenshots to plan and execute real actions.
Architected a full-stack agent system streaming voice, DOM, and screenshot data over WebSockets to a FastAPI backend orchestrating a Google ADK agent powered by Gemini.
Implemented multi-tool agent planning so the agent reasons over available tools (DOM actions, browser control, WebMCP, screenshots, image generation) to execute multi-step tasks.
